document.title: Microbially induced calcite precipitation in sand columns: group- and time-resolved evidence

sections.heading: Materials and Methods
sections.text: Sporosarcina pasteurii (ATCC 11859) was cultured in B4 medium at 30 C for 48 h. Urease activity reached 0.8 mM urea/min/OD. Urea concentration 0.5 M and CaCl2 0.5 M were injected in three treatment rounds. Columns 50 mm diameter, 100 mm tall.

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: UCS reached 3.2 MPa after 14 days of treatment. CaCO3 content was 12 percent at day 28.
